card.name: Partway through medical terms and phrases
card.fires_on: Words inside or just before a longer medical term, such as the E in IgE, aine in migraine, RP in CGRP, or 'of' after 'any component'. It also fires on 'normal' before 'ups and downs'.

modes.label: Inside medical terms
modes.description: The marked piece sits inside a longer condition, drug-class or system name, with the rest of the term to follow.

modes.label: 'of' after component
modes.description: The word 'of' in contraindication wording about any component of the product.
modes.example: hypersensitive to any component<< of>> this product and in patients with a history
